findings.issue: Removing more than available stock does not raise ValueError; it creates negative inventory.
findings.fix: Check qty against item.qty before decrementing and raise ValueError when it exceeds current stock.
findings.evidence: SPEC.md requires ValueError for excess qty. Manual execution after adding qty 3 and removing 4 produced no exception and qty=-1.

findings.issue: Items exactly at the threshold are omitted because the comparison is strict less-than.
findings.fix: Use qty <= threshold when filtering SKUs.
findings.evidence: SPEC.md defines low stock as qty <= threshold. Manual execution with qty 2 and threshold 2 returned []

findings.issue: The test suite exercises only add and total value, leaving both remove-overdraw and threshold-equality contracts unguarded.
findings.fix: Add focused tests asserting excess removal raises ValueError and an item at the threshold is returned by low_stock.
findings.evidence: test_stock.py contains one test, test_add_and_total; pytest -q passes 1 test despite both manual contract failures.
